# Hooks

<!-- Generated by packages/kyrn-judge/test/golden/hooks.test.ts. Do not edit by hand: run `npx vitest --run test/golden -u` from packages/kyrn-judge. -->

What each part of mu registers with pi, recorded with every feature switched on. The features register in the
order of the table in `packages/kyrn-judge/src/extension/kyrn-judge.ts`, and pi calls an event's handlers in the
order they were registered, except that `tool_call` handlers registered as final run after all the others. So
the order under each event is the order its handlers run in. `kernel` is what mu registers around the features.

The features, in that order: `interjection`, `preflight`, `frame`, `memory`, `procedures`, `evolve`, `snapshot`, `preload`, `skills`, `catalog`, `injection`, `guard`, `constraints`, `plan`, `permissions`, `admission`, `forgetting`, `recall`, `askUser`, `present`, `compaction` (off by default), `monitor`, `ttsr` (off by default), `deadline`, `watchdog`, `interrupted`, `lsp`, `goal`, `completion`, `continuation`, `board`, `checkpoint`, `notify`, `warming`, `warmup`, `prefix`, `swarm`, `hive`, `tools`, `judgeItems`, `browser`, `inherit`, `mcp`, `confine` (off by default), `background`, `sandbox` (off by default), `web`, `packs`, `googleLogin`, `featureOffers`, `recovery`.

## What features share on the runtime

Fields of `KyrnRuntime` (`src/extension/runtime.ts`) that code outside it sets, with the files that read them,
found by searching `src` for `runtime.<field>` (and `this.<field>` in runtime.ts). A field more than one file sets
is marked: two features that set it in the same turn decide between them by the order above.

| field | set by | read by |
|---|---|---|
| `addChecklist` | `extension/features/frame.ts` | `extension/features/plan.ts` |
| `capabilitiesOpen` | `extension/features/catalog.ts` | `extension/features/swarm.ts` |
| `deadlineAt` | `extension/features/deadline.ts` | `extension/features/deadline.ts`, `extension/features/watchdog.ts` |
| `enabled` | `extension/kyrn-judge.ts` | `extension/features/commands.ts`, `extension/features/welcome.ts`, `extension/runtime.ts` |
| `evolve` | `extension/features/evolve.ts` | `extension/features/ask-user.ts`, `extension/features/commands.ts`, `extension/features/interjection.ts`, `extension/features/permissions.ts`, `extension/features/preload.ts`, `extension/features/snapshot.ts` |
| `floor` | `extension/features/confine.ts` | `extension/features/background.ts`, `extension/features/packs/debugger.ts` |
| `floorExit` | `extension/features/confine.ts` | `extension/features/background.ts`, `extension/features/confine.ts`, `extension/features/permissions.ts` |
| `frameState` | `extension/features/frame.ts` | `extension/features/frame.ts`, `extension/features/interjection.ts`, `extension/runtime.ts` |
| `goalActive` | `extension/features/goal.ts` | `extension/features/board.ts`, `extension/features/completion.ts`, `extension/features/continuation.ts` |
| `harnessAbort` (set in more than one file) | `extension/features/ttsr.ts`, `extension/features/watchdog.ts` | `extension/features/completion.ts`, `extension/features/continuation.ts`, `extension/features/evolve.ts`, `extension/features/goal.ts`, `extension/features/interrupted.ts` |
